moves.description:
Activation Condition: When the user uses any moves 1 time.

Never misses. Applies the Restrain effect to the target and the user. If the remaining MP for the user’s Sitrus Berry is zero when attacking with this move, restores its HP by approximately 10% of its maximum HP.
